definition: a copy made to look like the real thing
description: In a bright restoration studio full of white plaster busts on shelves, a young woman in a white lab coat and gloves rubs a long cotton swab on the cheek of a bust of a man that looks like old brown marble. Where she cleans, the brown colour comes off and plain white plaster shows underneath. She leans in, frowns with doubt and touches the white patch with her finger. A tray of used cotton swabs, white powder and a jar of liquid lie around it, and two colleagues work behind her.

en.question: What is the woman in front doing?

de.answer: Sie reibt die Büste mit einem Wattestäbchen ab.
de.question: Was macht die Frau vorne?

es.answer: Está frotando el busto con un bastoncillo de algodón.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer de delante?

fr.answer: Elle frotte le buste avec un coton-tige.
